comments: // One diesel generator Gen1 of isochronous mode is installed at the swing bus,
// Another diesel generator Gen2 of constant_P and v/q droop mode is placed at bus 8
// At 2001-08-01 12:00:30.001 PST, microgrid_switch3 opens, and part of feeder is not supported by the power eneration
// Gen 1 thereforely decreases its power to maintain the frequency,
// Gen 2 tries to maintain its constant P values, and adjust its Q output based on the v/q droop
// When comes to the steady state, the frequency is back to the norminal one, with Gen 2 PQ output the same as the conditions bwfore the switch opens
